description: ADR 01186: every report a run writes validates against report_v3, through the real CLI. A routing miss fails the step that routed instead of adding a step of its own, a skipped context's empty `steps` validates, and a run with no tests writes the full report shape. Node only, so it PASSes on every platform.

tests.description: Writes the specs the other tests run.
Runs a routed, a skipped, and an empty input, then validates each results file against report_v3.

steps.description: Every results file validates. The routed run's first step FAILs with the routing reason, and no extra step is reported.

runShell.command: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const {validate}=require('./src/common/dist/index.cjs');const read=(n)=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('.tmp/fixture-report/'+n+'.json','utf8'));const bad=[];for (const n of ['routed','skipped','empty']) {const r=validate({schemaKey:'report_v3',object:read(n),addDefaults:false});if(!r.valid) bad.push(n+': '+r.errors)}const steps=read('routed').specs[0].tests[0].contexts.find((c)=>c.result!=='SKIPPED').steps;if(steps.length!==2||steps[0].result!=='FAIL'||!/Couldn't route to step .nope.: no step has that .stepId.\.$/.test(steps[0].resultDescription)) bad.push('routed steps: '+JSON.stringify(steps));if(bad.length){console.error(bad.join('\n'));process.exit(1)}"
